provider.description: What serves it: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or your own signed-in Claude Code CLI on your Claude subscription (docs/04 The Claude Code provider; never an API key).

endpoint.description: An OpenAI-compatible base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 (llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama's /v1). Not for claude-code.

model.description: The model id a request names; the profile's name when unset. For claude-code: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, a full id, or auto (pacing picks per turn); default: the CLI's.

pacing.description: claude-code with model auto: the models to pick from, strongest first, and the plan's windows to pace against (docs/04 Pacing).

target.description: session: spend each 5-hour window fully; week: stretch the weekly limit across the week; both: the stricter of the two.

contextWindow.description: Tokens; 0 when unknown (a context error reveals it).

maxOutput.description: Tokens a reply may take; 0 leaves it to the server.

vision.description: Whether the images tool results show are sent to it (a vision model; llama.cpp with its projector). Left out: what its server says (llama.cpp's /props modalities, asked once per server run); Test connection shows it.

effort.description: What each effort adds to a request: the fields written into it, e.g. {"low": {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": false}}}. A level left out adds nothing. Left out: a llama.cpp server is sent chat_template_kwargs.reasoning_effort, any other server reasoning_effort (docs/04 Model groups and roles).

env.description: The environment variable that holds the key. Keys never live in settings files.

prefillRate.description: Prompt tokens per second assumed until one is measured (default 150).

ai.models.description: Model profiles by name: where each model is served and how to talk to it (docs/04 Providers).

ai.groups.description: Model groups by name: per role (primary, planning, worker, summarizer, ...) a model, temperature, effort and fallbacks (docs/04 Model groups).

ai.defaultGroup.description: The group a new chat uses; empty: the first group.

ai.permissions.description: Rules for the AI's tool calls (docs/11): deny, then confirm (always ask), then the chat's permission mode, then allow. A rule is kind(pattern): shell(nuke build *), fs.write(src/**), fs.*(secrets/**).

ai.maxSteps.description: Model requests one turn may make before it pauses; 0 is no limit (docs/12 Budgets). Loop and no-progress detection still pause a turn that runs away.

ai.claude.command.description: The Claude Code CLI's program and leading arguments. Empty: claude.exe on PATH, then the native installer's (%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin), WinGet's link, then the newest the Claude desktop app keeps (the app from Anthropic's installer or the Microsoft Store). Sign in to it with your Claude subscription (Settings > AI > Claude > Sign in, or claude auth login in a terminal of your own): IED never handles Claude credentials and never runs Claude on an API key.

ai.claude.usageRefreshMinutes.description: How often the plan's usage (the 5-hour session and the week) is asked of the CLI while a claude-code model is set up; 0: only when asked and after Claude turns. Asking spends no usage.

ai.tools.loadAll.description: Send every tool's definition with every request. Off, plugin tools and tool groups are listed by name and loaded on demand with tool_search, which keeps the context small (docs/13 Loading tools on demand).
